title: Remove rows with DELETE
description: Write a statement that deletes every order with status `'cancelled'` from the `orders` table.
hints: 💡 SQL concept to consider: DELETE FROM ... WHERE
DELETE FROM table WHERE condition removes only the matching rows - just like UPDATE, leaving out WHERE deletes the entire table's contents.
Scope the DELETE with WHERE status = 'cancelled' so only cancelled orders are affected.
explanation: DELETE removes whole rows, never individual column values - WHERE narrows down which rows qualify, the same role it plays in SELECT and UPDATE.

hidden_tests.check_query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
